title: Room-temperature quantum-sensing molecular crystals grown in minutes
summary: Quantum sensing increasingly demands materials combining room-temperature optical spin addressability and coherent control with rapid, accessible fabrication. Yet semiconductor platforms require costly materials and specialized processing, while molecular systems often depend on bespoke synthesis or involved crystal growth. Here we apply microspacing in-air sublimation (MAS) to rapidly fabricate quantum-sensing materials within minutes.
